literal: In a single birth, the action that a fool performs is a hell in which he himself, entering, will sink for all seven births.
translation: The deed that a fool performs in a single birth is a hell into which he himself will enter and sink for all seven births.
modern: ஒரு பிறவியில் அறிவிலி செய்யும் செயலானது, அவன் ஏழு பிறவிகளிலும் தானே புகுந்து மூழ்கிக் கிடக்கும் நரகமாக மாறும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the long-lasting consequences of foolish actions. A fool performs a deed in a single lifetime without foresight or wisdom. This single action becomes like a deep, miry hell into which he himself must enter and sink repeatedly across all seven of his future births. The poet emphasizes that the suffering is self-inflicted and enduring, highlighting the gravity of foolishness.
